Experimental_Design.Conditions: 3 (cue identity: own-face name, stranger name 1, stranger name 2) x 3 (target identity: own face, stranger face 1, stranger face 2) within-subjects; each cue followed by each target with equal probability (33.3%)

Trial_Structure.Stimulus_duration: Label: 200 ms; Face: until response (max 2000 ms)
Trial_Structure.SOA: 1200 ms (label onset to face onset; 1 s delay between label offset and face onset)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: Faces: participant's own photograph (taken at the start of the session with controlled lighting and white background, not mirror-reversed) + two Chicago Face Database faces; total picture 8 deg x 8 deg, face alone approx. 3.8 deg x 5.3 deg; own face always associated with a stranger's name, two other faces with stranger names (Liz/Meg/Pam for female, Rob/Ned/Sam for male participants; name changed to Kat/Ken if it coincided with the participant's name); assignment counterbalanced across participants
Stimulus_Properties.Label: Names of equal length (3 letters, width 2 deg)

exp2.detail: Experiment 2: association of the participant's own real face with a stranger's name (no 'You' label). 29 participants tested, 5 excluded due to technical issues during preparation of photographs; 24 analyzed (17 Asian-face and 7 White-face versions; 12 female/12 male; age 18-35, M=21.8, SD=3.65; 3 left-handed). Task structure identical to Exp1 (learning phase 3 x 20 s; 24 practice trials; 3 blocks x 90 = 270 test trials; z/m keys counterbalanced). Identity coding (author internal codes You/Neutral/AntiYou): AntiYou = Own face (Self, associated with a stranger's name), You/Neutral = Stranger. Per-subject which name is linked to the own face is given by raw columns 14-16 (the own-face name is the one whose code is AntiYou). Data: 24 subjects x 270 test trials = 6480 rows. ACC: 1 correct / 0 incorrect / NA no response (key 'x'); RT_ms in ms, NA for no-response. Source: OSF 2q9w7, DATA/SelfBoostExp_2xxx.dat; note 2 files (2008/2011) have line-level SubNum differing from filename (author renamed files; filename is the subject ID, see Issue 4 in Verifying_original_results_issues.md).
